newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Dupont Dow Elastomers makes Singapore its Asian HQ.
newsitem.headline: Dupont Dow Elastomers makes Singapore its Asian HQ.

text.p: Dupont Dow Elastomers Pte Ltd said on Wednesday its Asian operations had been awarded business headquarters status (BHQ) by Singapore.
Dupont Dow, a 50:50 joint venture of U.S. chemical firms E.I. Du Pont de Nemours & Co and Dow Chemical Co, makes a range of industrial plastics and rubber products, the company said in a statement.
BHQ status allows companies to reduce their tax bill by as much as 16 percentage points from Singapore's standard 26 percent corporate rate.
The statement did not say how much the company's tax rate would be reduced by the change in status.
